targetTasks.summary: Current window: AlembicPlugin. Claim only task rg10-plugin-plan-project-context-empty-repair-t1 under stateRoot .wakeflow-active/current/alembic-recipe-evolution-optimization-2026-06-21. Read AlembicPlugin/AGENTS.md, parent AGENTS.md, active index/status, this state root, RG-10 Test target result, controller evidence rg10-test-bilidili-scenario-acceptance-controller-review.md, and the Test evidence summary before editing. Context: RG0-RG9 were accepted at Plugin commit 13c52f18c3a5e5411f838277c9ccc0636b43ba7c and Core commit a156e0d796d396e02d815ca22147c83d59bf880b. RG-10 Test built a fresh local MCP from those accepted sources and proved alembic_plan exists, but alembic_plan draft returned PLAN_PROJECT_CONTEXT_EMPTY for BiliDili in Ghost-mode Test/tmp, Ghost-mode sibling, and standard-mode sibling worktrees despite visible Swift files; alembic_bootstrap testMode correctly returned PLAN_REQUIRED, so Test cannot proceed without bypassing the Plan gate. Goal: repair the Plan ProjectContext collection path so alembic_plan draft on a fresh initialized real Swift project can produce a non-empty, ProjectContext-grounded Plan draft. Primary code to inspect: lib/recipe-generation/plan-tool.ts collectPlanProjectContext/draftPlan, lib/recipe-generation/host-agent-workflows/project-context-analysis.ts, ProjectContextCapabilities.execute usage, and MCP routing. Required behavior: (1) alembic_plan draft must not return PLAN_PROJECT_CONTEXT_EMPTY for a real project whose ProjectContext repo/space facts can see source files; it must collect non-empty file/module facts from Core ProjectContext or a bounded factual ProjectContext-compatible fallback before saving a draft. (2) For BiliDili-like Swift projects, recommended dimensions and scale must be grounded in actual project signals such as Swift/SwiftUI/UIKit/networking/concurrency/module layout where present, not language-only guessing. (3) Keep confirmed Plan as hard prerequisite: alembic_bootstrap must still block with PLAN_REQUIRED until a Plan is confirmed. (4) Do not fake dimensions, do not double-write Plan/generation state, do not remove evidence/proposal/vector structures, do not change public semantics of existing four tools beyond the RG-10 repair. (5) If investigation proves Core ProjectContext public capability itself returns empty for fresh Swift projects and Plugin cannot correctly call an existing Core route, return blocked with a precise Core repair request and raw reproduction evidence instead of masking it. Expected implementation evidence: focused tests or fixtures that reproduce the empty ProjectContext Plan draft failure and verify the repaired draft path; regression test for bootstrap remaining PLAN_REQUIRED before confirmation; build/check or the smallest repository validation covering changed surfaces; git status and commit hash. Do not run the full RG-10 BiliDili Test chain in this Plugin task; just provide enough evidence for controller to redispatch RG-10 Test after repair.
